_comment: EVENT-HARNESS Study 2 ON base: the sim golden with the SINGLE knob under test armed.
network.carry_rx_clock_in_block gives the station receiver clock — a LOCAL A_r column with
NO temporal prior on the network path — a random walk about a carried drift, INSIDE the F3
whitened local block.  Everything else is golden_sim_tri_w6 verbatim (extends chain).
It is FINGERPRINTED (armed-only conditional append, NetworkRunContext.cpp), so the ON arm
needs its OWN 6 h seed; runs/evseed_rxclk6h is that seed.  q/rate/jump/isb are left at the
loader defaults (q 0.09 m^2/epoch, rate_var0 1.0, rate_q 1e-10, jump_k 10, isb true).
